class.name: NNBTBlackboardCompare
class.brief_description: Condition leaf that compares a blackboard value against a target value.
class.description: Reads [member key] from the tree's blackboard and compares it to [member value] using [member operator], returning [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] if true and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] otherwise (including when the key is missing, [code]null[/code], or of an incompatible type). Use to branch on blackboard state without writing a custom condition script.

members.member: Comparison operator applied as [code]blackboard_value <op> value[/code]. See [enum Operator].
Value to compare the stored blackboard value against.

constants.constant: The stored value does not equal [member value].
The stored value is greater than [member value].
The stored value is less than [member value].
The stored value is greater than or equal to [member value].
The stored value is less than or equal to [member value].
